text:
Ada (CS): Quick heads-up — VerdureHealth onboarding 11:00 PT. Account health = watch (trial, sporadic cold-starts). Renewal ~34 days. Need a 1-page preflight we can send: warmup, minimal prefetch, simple batching, streaming fallback, and a single-click feedback link.

Luis (Eng): Short plan: prefetch top-6 prompts, continuous batching target ~25ms, max batch 12, streaming with chunk_size=256 and chunk_fallback. Recommend synthetic warmup 25m prior with 25 concurrent requests. Example warmup we can give them:
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/route/verdure-prod/warmup -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"prompt":"sample"}' &
(repeat 25 times in background)

Priya (SRE): SRE constraints: route timeout 6s, error-alert if route_errors > 3% for 3m, flip to canary-model if p95>900ms for 4m. I'll add an ephemeral pager for the 30m window. Also watch kv_hit_rate; include it on the dashboard.

Gabe (PM): I'll own the customer-facing checklist and feedback capture. Post-call micro-survey: 3 quick Qs (latency ok? quality ok? blockers?). Negative -> tag renewal risk. I'll make a short form and post link in this thread.

Ada (CS): Can WarmupBot schedule and capture kv_hit_rate + first-token p50 pre/post so we can show the delta live? Also confirm private deploy KV sizing recommendation.

WarmupBot: Warmup scheduled by Luis: id=wb-2100000000 run_at=2027-02-10T10:35:00Z concurrency=25 route=verdure-prod. Logs -> /warmups/wb-2100000000 :white_check_mark:

Luis (Eng): For private installs suggest KV cache 600MB and int8 quantization when acceptable. Hosted: reserve L-series burst for 30m window and set prefix_TTL=10m.

Priya (SRE): I'll add the alert and dashboard tile; pager only if errors>5% or p95>1200ms to avoid noise.

Gabe (PM): Action recap: Gabe builds checklist & form, Luis schedules warmup and posts final script, Priya wires alert & pager, Ada runs preflight 20m prior and posts results in thread.

Ada (CS): Thanks all — I'll send the one-page preflight to the customer and paste the checklist here before EOD.
